name: Baby Corn
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in SIBO due to low fiber content and easy digestibility compared to mature corn.
preparationTips: Can be eaten raw in salads or lightly steamed for 2-3 minutes
Add to stir-fries in the last few minutes to maintain crunch
Drain canned baby corn thoroughly and rinse to remove excess sodium
Slice lengthwise for faster cooking and better flavor absorption
